column3: “And all their host” preserves the additional coordinated phrase rather than “in all their vast array.”
“On the seventh day” preserves the temporal expression rather than “by the seventh day”; the second clause repeats “the seventh day” and “which He had done.”
The concluding phrase is “which God created to make,” preserving a distinct infinitive rather than simply “that He had accomplished.”
The final clause explicitly repeats “earth and heavens,” in that order, rather than “them.”
“In the middle of the garden” directly accompanies the tree of life; the tree of knowledge follows as a further coordinated tree.
“Four heads” preserves the image represented by “four headwaters.”
The gold is called “good,” rather than specifically “pure.”
“A help corresponding to him” preserves the relational image behind “a suitable helper.”
“He did not find” preserves the active form rather than “no suitable helper was found.”
“And he slept” remains a distinct coordinated clause rather than “while he slept.”
“Built the rib … into a woman” preserves the building image rendered simply “made a woman.”
